title: Act: Confirm BootScene creates, clicks and destroys character sprites
summary: Confirm BootScene create, createCharacter and shutdown handle characters.
description: Read BootScene.ts and confirm characters are created from scene.characters, characterClick is emitted before animation guards, and shutdown destroys sprites. Edit only if missing.
acceptance_criteria: The shutdown handler destroys each character sprite and clears the array
POINTER_DOWN emits characterClick before the interact guards

steps.action: Check this.characterSprites is assigned from (scene.characters ?? []).map(createCharacter) and the SHUTDOWN callback runs characterSprites.forEach((s) => s.destroy()); restore if missing.
steps.expected: Assignment, destroy and reset lines are listed.

steps.action: Check the POINTER_DOWN handler calls phaserToReact.emit('characterClick', { id: spec.id }) before the idleKey and interactKey guards; reorder only if wrong.
